To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AIIMS Delhi to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences Delhi (AIIMS Delhi) for project-based research positions under the DevYA project.

faq.question: Q2. What positions are available in AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions include Project Technical Support - I and Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) with a total of 3 vacancies across India.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 15-10-2026. Candidates must ensure they complete the submission before 5:00 PM on this date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The mode of application is online. Candidates are required to upload their CV and relevant documents in a single PDF via the designated Google Form link.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for Project Technical Support - I?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Project Technical Support - I post must hold a B.Sc or M.Sc degree along with knowledge of working in a clinical set-up.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are needed for Project Research Scientist-I?
faq.answer: Applicants for the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) position need to possess a B.Tech, M.Tech, M.Sc., or Ph.D. degree with expertise in Neuroimaging.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 38 years for the Project Technical Support - I post and 35 years for the Project Research Scientist-I post.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification for any of the categories applying for these project positions.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves initial shortlisting of candidates based on their qualifications followed by an in-person interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification link?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification PDF and direct application links in the Important Links section of this recruitment article.
